new_result.statement: For every 0<eta<=1/sqrt(63), there is an independent scalar H and a residual triple (T,V,W) with joint density cap 1 and coordinate 1D/2D marginal caps <=1 such that the exact rank-three near-coloop coefficient matrix for Q=2HW+2eta TW+V^2 has spectrum {-sqrt(1+eta^2),0,1,sqrt(1+eta^2)}, q=1/(1+eta^2)>=63/64, while Q has logarithmically unbounded density. Simultaneously, the r46 hyperbolic-plus-puncture component has ||p||_3^3<=6 and V^2 has ||p||_(3/2)=2. Therefore same-bank L3 x L32 closure cannot use only marginal/joint caps; orthogonal product-projection provenance is essential.

not_a_target_counterexample_reason: The residual triple is produced by the nonlinear map T=R-V^2/(2eta W) from independent centered unit uniforms R,V,W, not by an exhibited orthogonal linear projection of an original cap-one product source. Pulled back to the independent variables, the third square cancels and the form has rank two.
unresolved: QFORM-R46-ORTHOGONAL-PRODUCT-L3-L32-TRACE-v1: exploit the exact orthogonal product-projection characteristic-function factorization or equivalent source-disjoint bank decomposition to remove the log while retaining the puncture and W^2 phase.
